sections.title: What is a Chiller?
sections.learningObjective: Understand what a chiller does and why it matters in HVAC systems
keyPoints: A chiller removes heat from water
Chilled water circulates to cool buildings
Central equipment in large cooling systems

sections.title: Four Main Components
sections.learningObjective: Identify the four key components of a chiller

sections.title: The Refrigeration Cycle
sections.learningObjective: Understand how refrigerant flows through the cycle
keyPoints: Refrigerant evaporates in evaporator, absorbing heat
Refrigerant condenses in condenser, rejecting heat
Expansion valve drops pressure to restart cycle

sections.title: Summary
sections.learningObjective: Recap the key principles of chiller operation
